name: Olay Natural Aura Natural Cream 50gm Combo Pack (Thailand)
description:
Product Name: Olay Natural Aura Natural Cream (Combo Pack)
Net Weight: 50gm
Brand: Olay
Form: Cream
Type: Day & Night Cream Combo

Key Features & Benefits

Radiant Skin: Brightens up the skin and gives a healthy-looking natural glow within 14 days.

Dark Spot Reduction: Effectively reduces the appearance of dark spots, freckles, and sun spots.

SPF 24 Protection: Day cream protects against harmful UV radiation.

Natural Ingredients: Gentle formulation suitable for daily use.

Deep Hydration: Restores lost moisture and keeps skin soft, smooth, and nourished.

Day & Night Care:

Day Cream – Lightweight with SPF 24 to protect and brighten.

Night Cream – Richer and creamier to hydrate, repair, and reduce dark spots overnight.
